root_cause: Direct Composio tool execution still used /api/v3, whose default tool version resolved to the pinned base toolkit. Modern LinkedIn tools then failed with HTTP 400 even though the connected account itself was active.
prevention: Use Composio /api/v3.1 for direct tool execution so current tool versions resolve correctly.
Keep connected-account discovery and tool execution version semantics aligned.
Regression-test both LinkedIn capability execution and the shared Instagram Composio publisher transport.
